title: nf-core/tandemrepeat pipeline parameters
description: Schema for the parameters of the nf-core/tandemrepeat pipeline

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Path to comma-separated file containing information about the samples in the experiment.
input.help_text: You will need to create a design file with information about the samples in your experiment before running the pipeline. Use this parameter to specify its location. It has to be a comma-separated file with 2 columns, and a header row.

fasta.help_text: If you don't have a samplesheet, you can provide a single FASTA file directly using this parameter.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved.

email_on_fail.description: An email address to send a summary email to when the pipeline is completed - ONLY sent if the pipeline does not exit successfully.

plaintext_email.description: Send plain-text email instead of HTML.

monochrome_logs.description: Do not use coloured log outputs.

tool_selection_options.title: Tool selection options
tool_selection_options.description: Choose which tandem repeat detection tools to run.

tools.description: Tools to use for tandem repeat detection.
tools.help_text: Specify which tools to run for tandem repeat annotation. Multiple tools can be specified using commas (e.g., 'trf,ultra'). Available tools: trf (Tandem Repeats Finder), ultra (ULTRA annotator), vampire (Vampire TR detector).

trf_match.help_text: The weight for matching symbols in the alignment.

trf_minscore.help_text: The minimum alignment score to report a tandem repeat.

trf_maxperiod.help_text: The maximum period size (repeat unit length) to report.

ultra_options.title: ULTRA options
ultra_options.description: Parameters for ULTRA tandem repeat annotator.

ultra_annot.description: ULTRA annotation mode or additional parameters.
ultra_annot.help_text: Optional annotation parameters for ULTRA. Can be used to specify custom annotation files or modes.

vampire_options.title: Vampire options
vampire_options.description: Parameters for Vampire tandem repeat detector.

vampire_min_motif_size.help_text: Minimum size of the repeat motif to detect.

vampire_max_motif_size.help_text: Maximum size of the repeat motif to detect.

institutional_config_options.title: Institutional config options
institutional_config_options.description: Parameters used to describe centralised config profiles. These should not be edited.
institutional_config_options.help_text: The centralised nf-core config profiles use a handful of pipeline parameters to describe themselves. This information is then printed to the Nextflow log when you run a pipeline. You should not need to use these parameters directly.

custom_config_version.description: Git commit id for Institutional configs.

config_profile_name.description: Institutional config name used for the pipeline run.

max_job_request_options.title: Max job request options
max_job_request_options.description: Set the top limit for requested resources for any single job.
max_job_request_options.help_text: If you are running on a limited cluster environment, you can use these parameters to set a top limit for the resources requested by any single job. This can help prevent the pipeline from failing due to requesting too many resources.

max_cpus.description: Maximum number of CPUs that can be requested for any single job.

max_memory.description: Maximum amount of memory that can be requested for any single job.

max_time.description: Maximum amount of time that can be requested for any single job.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.
generic_options.help_text: These options are common to all nf-core pipelines and allow you to customise the pipeline run in a variety of ways. They are typically set in the Nextflow config file rather than on the command line.

help_full.description: Display help text with all parameters.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to output directory.
publish_dir_mode.help_text: The Nextflow `publishDir` option specifies which intermediate files should be saved to the output directory. This option tells the pipeline what method should be used to move these files. See [Nextflow docs](https://www.nextflow.io/docs/latest/process.html#publishdir) for details.

multiqc_config.description: Custom config file to supply to MultiQC.

multiqc_title.description: MultiQC report title. Printed as page header, used for filename if not otherwise specified.

multiqc_logo.description: Custom logo file to supply to MultiQC. File name must also be set in the MultiQC config file.

multiqc_methods_description.description: Custom MultiQC yaml file containing HTML including a methods description.

max_multiqc_email_size.description: Threshold size for MultiQC report to be attached in notification email.

show_hidden.description: Show all hidden parameters in the help output.
